meta.title: Roadmap & Changelog
meta.description: What's shipping now, what's next, and everything WakeMark has shipped — from X bookmark sync and AI auto-tagging to the Chrome extension, Notion sync, and the Shadowban Checker.

hero.title: Shipped, shipping, and what's next
hero.description: WakeMark turns your X bookmark graveyard into a living library. Here's what we've shipped so far — and where we're heading.

home.title: Better as you grow.
home.subtitle: New features every week to keep pace with you.

upcoming.title: On the roadmap
upcoming.description: What we're building next, in rough order of arrival.

items.title: Semantic search
items.description: Search by meaning, not keywords — "that thread about pricing pages" will just work, even if you never saved it with those words.

items.title: Smart collections
items.description: Lists that fill themselves: pick a topic and WakeMark keeps adding matching bookmarks as they sync.

items.title: Highlights & notes
items.description: Annotate any bookmark, then filter and digest your notes alongside the original tweets.

items.title: Digest scheduling presets
items.description: One-tap schedules — weekday mornings, Friday recap, monthly deep-clean — with timezone-aware delivery.

items.title: WakeMark for mobile
items.description: A reading-first mobile experience for digests and lists, so catch-up doesn't need a desk.

shipped.title: Shipped
shipped.description: Everything that's already live, newest first.

releases.title: Shadowban Checker
releases.description: Free Health tab in the Chrome extension: test search ban, suggestion ban, sensitive flags, and account privacy from a logged-out guest session — no WakeMark login required.

releases.title: Notion sync & bookmark export
releases.description: Connect Notion and auto-sync AI-tagged bookmarks into a database, or download Markdown, JSON, or CSV from the dashboard anytime.

releases.title: Import bookmark history
releases.description: X's official API only returns your newest ~20 bookmarks. The Chrome extension scrolls your bookmarks page and uploads the rest.

releases.title: Chrome extension
releases.description: Search your library and Ask AI from any tab — toolbar popup or a persistent side panel, same account as wakemark.app.

releases.title: MCP Server
releases.description: Connect Claude, Cursor, Codex or ChatGPT with a single API key — agents can search, read and organize your bookmarks right where you already work.

releases.title: Chat AI
releases.description: Ask a question, get an instant answer pulled from your own saved tweets, with links back to the original posts.

releases.title: Shareable lists
releases.description: Turn any tag or topic into a themed list and share it with a public link — your curated feed, without the follower count.

releases.title: Email Digest
releases.description: A clean, topic-grouped briefing of your recent bookmarks, delivered daily or weekly on your schedule.

releases.title: Search & filters
releases.description: Full-text search across every bookmark you've saved, with tag filters and sorting by date or engagement.

releases.title: Sync & AI auto-tagging
releases.description: WakeMark launches: connect X once and every bookmark syncs automatically, tagged by topic before you even open the app.
